timing_design: One non-authoritative warm-up precedes authoritative timing. Policy execution is counterbalanced with a frozen 4x4 Latin-square order across seed and repeat; three repeats are interleaved rather than run policy-by-policy. Controller runtime excludes one-time model loading, instance generation, and trace construction.
timing_scope: controller execution only; excludes one-time model loading, instance generation, and context-trace construction
